compatibility_requirements.title: Case-insensitive string comparison
compatibility_requirements.target_guidance: Preserve locale-aware VBA text-comparison semantics for affected string comparisons; do not assume Java String.equalsIgnoreCase is fully equivalent.

compatibility_requirements.title: One-based default array bounds
compatibility_requirements.target_guidance: Use an array abstraction that preserves explicit lower bounds and VBA default lower-bound rules.

compatibility_requirements.title: VBA On Error runtime semantics
compatibility_requirements.target_guidance: Implement a compatibility runtime for Resume Next, GoTo handler, GoTo 0, Err state and handler activation; this pass preserves directives but does not emulate execution.

compatibility_requirements.title: Legacy GoSub/Return control flow
compatibility_requirements.target_guidance: Lower GoSub to an explicit continuation/return stack or a proven equivalent; never map Return to Java method return.

compatibility_requirements.title: Late-bound COM/Object members
compatibility_requirements.target_guidance: Define explicit Java interfaces/adapters for the actual COM object behavior. Object-typed references alone do not identify the target API.

compatibility_requirements.title: COM object activation
compatibility_requirements.target_guidance: Replace ProgID-based activation with an explicit Java implementation or integration adapter; preserve fallback behavior.

compatibility_requirements.title: ByRef parameter mutation
compatibility_requirements.target_guidance: Generate mutable holders or pass mutable record/array references so writes in the callee are visible to the caller.

compatibility_requirements.title: IIf evaluates both result expressions
compatibility_requirements.target_guidance: Do not translate IIf to Java’s lazy conditional operator without checking side effects and exceptions; VBA IIf evaluates both branches.

compatibility_requirements.title: DoEvents cooperative yield
compatibility_requirements.target_guidance: Decide whether a Java event-loop/thread-yield equivalent is required; a no-op changes responsiveness semantics.

compatibility_requirements.title: Dynamic arrays, ReDim, Preserve and Erase
compatibility_requirements.target_guidance: Implement resizable arrays with preserved lower/upper bounds, element copying, and Erase semantics.

compatibility_requirements.title: VBA Currency fixed-point arithmetic
compatibility_requirements.target_guidance: Use fixed-point decimal arithmetic with four decimal places and verify rounding/overflow rules.

compatibility_requirements.title: VBA Date representation
compatibility_requirements.target_guidance: Map VBA/OLE Automation dates carefully; verify serial-date conversions, timezone assumptions and date parsing/formatting.

compatibility_requirements.title: Variant dynamic values
compatibility_requirements.target_guidance: Preserve runtime type changes, Empty/Null distinctions, arrays stored in Variant, and VBA conversion rules.

compatibility_requirements.title: VBA Collection semantics
compatibility_requirements.target_guidance: Preserve insertion order, one-based Item indexing, Count, Add and Remove behavior.

compatibility_requirements.title: Double-Not dynamic-array initialization check
compatibility_requirements.target_guidance: Confirm the source runtime meaning and replace with an explicit initialized/uninitialized array state in Java. Do not translate Not Not as ordinary boolean negation.

compatibility_requirements.title: VBA Is object-reference comparison
compatibility_requirements.target_guidance: Preserve object identity/null comparison semantics; distinguish Is from value equality.

evidence.source: Not m_AuditLog Is Nothing And m_AuditLog.Count > 0

compatibility_requirements.title: Bitwise logical operators on numeric values
compatibility_requirements.target_guidance: Preserve VBA bitwise behavior for numeric operands; do not map every And/Or expression to Java boolean operators.

known_limitations.description: DoEvents is represented by Thread.yield and does not provide Excel/VBA event-loop behavior.
Date, Currency, and number formatting follow Java locale/runtime rules, which may differ from the VBA host.
The pipeline converts Java exceptions to a failure report but cannot reproduce every VBA Err.Number, source, and handler transition.

accuracy_verification.note: The source-derived template is not certified as behaviorally equivalent until its input/output behavior is compared with VBA.
